name: Hour Weave
summary: A rounded mosque hall becomes a large time ring, interlocking with a narrow square minaret.
why: The dome, clock, and doorway share x=56. The minaret is joined directly to the hall and both end on y=74. A large true circular opening defines the dome as a structural ring; bold clock hands live within that opening, while the minaret channel repeats the same open-and-solid rhythm.
risk: The time motif is intentionally prominent. At 24px the hand angle remains readable while the smaller tower channel softens.
key1: A dome built as a time ring
sub1: Prayer timing in the main structure
reasonToChoose: You want a direct connection between mosque and prayer time.
